name_zh: 皮诺切特/智利/新自由/芝加哥/失踪/宪法/公投/奥古斯托/1980
description_zh: 奥古斯托·皮诺切特 (1915-2006) 智利总统 (1973-1990) 新自由主义经济学家，实施芝加哥经济学政策，通过1980年新宪法和全民公投巩固权力，领导军事独裁统治，推行大规模经济自由化，被誉为 "新自由实验室", 对拉美经济改革产生深远影响。
description_en: Augusto Pinochet (1915-2006) Chilean President (1973-1990) neoliberal economist, implemented Chicago economics policy, through 1980 new Constitution and plebiscite consolidated power, led military dictatorship, promoted large-scale economic liberalization, known as "neoliberal laboratory", had profound impact on Latin American economic reform.
reason_zh: 皮诺切特代表拉美军事独裁者如何通过经济改革实现国家现代化，如何通过宪法和公投巩固权力，以及如何推行新自由主义政策对拉美经济产生深远影响，体现了拉美经济转型的复杂性。
reason_en: Pinochet represents how Latin American military dictators achieve national modernization through economic reform, consolidate power through Constitution and plebiscite, and how neoliberal policies profoundly impact Latin American economy, embodies complexity of Latin American economic transformation.
